description: This file contains a single exported asynchronous function `listOrganizations` that fetches and processes a list of organizations (tenants) associated with the current user, making a GET request to the API endpoint `/session/tenants`. The function normalizes various possible data structures and keys, sorts the results, and handles errors.

methods.name: listOrganizations()
methods.description: Fetches a list of organizations (tenants), normalizes the data, sorts the list by name and id, and returns the normalized array.
